input.new_string:
"""Browser authentication-state boundary."""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import hmac
import time


def create_browser_auth_state(user_id: str, secret: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    issued_at = int(time.time())
    payload = f"{user_id}:{issued_at}"
    signature = hmac.new(secret.encode(), payload.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    cookie_value = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(f"{payload}:{signature}".encode()).decode()

    return {
        "name": "session",
        "value": cookie_value,
        "httponly": True,
        "secure": True,
        "samesite": "Lax",
        "path": "/",
    }
